clauses.clause: Handgun only at the armory, within 40 s of start; no reload/ammo UI over 600 shots; 40 HP infected = 2 hits.
clauses.note: All18 fresh WebGPU low/high frames inspected at0/100/200/300/400/500/600 actual handgun attacks. Full HUD has no reload/ammunition widget; 798 text samples per tier retain40low/35high allied “Reloading!” callout samples (ticks870–3165low/870–2415high); these are NPC speech, not courier reload/ammo UI. Source Allies.ts emits that exact callout; all18 HUD images show the courier icon without ammo/reload widgets. Normal armory acquisition at tick267 =4.45s; sole L3 grant is armory.onComplete at l3-armory (source inspection). Exact-current controlled40HP specimen dies after two20HP production hits in both tiers. No weapon/ammunition injection.
